meta.name: imaging-data-commons
meta.description: Query and download public cancer imaging data from NCI Imaging Data Commons using idc-index. Use for accessing large-scale radiology (CT, MR, PET) and pathology datasets for AI training or research. No authentication required. Query by metadata, visualize in browser, check licenses.

copy.tagline: 查询和下载公共癌症影像数据用于研究
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取大规模癌症影像数据集用于AI训练或学术研究
copy.tagline_en: Query and download public cancer imaging data for research
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access large-scale cancer imaging datasets for AI training or academic research

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询和下载美国国家癌症研究所影像数据共享中心（IDC）的公开癌症影像数据，包括CT、MR、PET和病理切片图像。它还能在浏览器中预览图像并检查数据许可证。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、筛选或下载癌症影像数据，或需要检查数据许可证时触发。

say.note: Claude 会查询 IDC 中肺癌相关的影像集合。
Claude 会下载指定集合的影像数据。

say.text: 检查IDC数据集的许可证信息。
say.note: Claude 会返回数据集的许可证类型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query and download public cancer imaging data from the NCI Imaging Data Commons (IDC), including CT, MR, PET, and pathology slide images. It can also visualize images in a browser and check data licenses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find, filter, or download cancer imaging data, or to check data licenses.

say_en.note: Claude will query IDC for lung cancer collections.

say_en.text: Download DICOM files from the TCGA-LUAD collection.
say_en.note: Claude will download the specified collection.

say_en.text: Check license info for IDC datasets.
say_en.note: Claude will return the license type.
